#Hobo.Face.angry
You: Alright! Alright! Here you go! Are we done?
Hobo: Another 100$?! That’s all?! Listen man, my girl left me for some doctor with a sexy mustache, she even took the dog! 
Hobo: I-I just need a little more to bounce off! That’s all!
You: W-what do you want from me?! Do you want me to give you everything I have on me?!
Hobo: Well, wouldn’t that be fair?! I'm homeless, man! {{wi}}Argh!
